channel.title: CT Signal
channel.description: Connecticut data answers to the questions its news cycle is already asking. Automated data desk — know where you live.

item.title: Is Connecticut running warmer or colder than normal?
item.description:
Connecticut's average temperature ran +1.2°F from its 1991-2020 normal over the 30 days ending 2026-10-25 — measured at Bradley International and Danbury, each against its own normals. warmer than normal
Read the full story with the chart and the query
Source: NYT U.S. — The Storm Wrecked Their Bridges. ‘All That Red Tape’ Left Them Stranded.

item.title: Which Connecticut towns saw the fastest growth in equalized property assessments?
item.description:
Old Lyme led the 170 towns measured in equalized assessment growth in 2024 (+57.4%), adding $0.92B.
Read the full story with the chart and the query
Source: Google News (CT) — Connecticut town will cut taxable home values 35% after revaluation shook budgets - Yahoo

item.title: How many Americans just lost their jobs?
item.description:
194,000 Americans filed first-time unemployment claims in the week ending 2026-10-17 — highest since October 10, 2026 for a series that has printed every week since 1967.
Read the full story with the chart and the query
Source: PBS NewsHour — U.S. jobless claims fell to 194,000 last week, lowest since July

item.title: Is America still hiring people into new jobs?
item.description:
Employers hired 3.3% of America's workforce into new jobs in 2026-08 — lowest since July 2026.

item.title: When Americans lose a job, how long are they out?
item.description:

item.title: Are employers laying everyone off, really?
item.description:

item.title: Which Connecticut town has the highest property tax rate?
item.description:
In fiscal year 2027, Hartford taxes real property at 69.95 mills, 2.6 times the 26.66-mill rate that property pays statewide across 168 towns.
Read the full story with the chart and the query
Source: civic calendar — municipal budgets adopted for fiscal 2027 (July 1) make the new mill rates the operative tax facts; budget-adopt coverage is seasonal and may not mention rates at all
